identity.name: Uncommon Remote Service Start via WMI
identity.summary: An attacker uses WMI to remotely start a service on a target host, which triggers a detection for an uncommon source initiating a service start. Cortex should flag this behavior as suspicious.
identity.description: An attacker uses WMI to remotely start a service on a target host, which triggers a detection for an uncommon source initiating a service start. Cortex should flag this behavior as suspicious.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Remote Service Start from Uncommon Source
biocs.description: Detection of a service start initiated from an unexpected source process (e.g., wmic.exe)
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'wmic.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'services.exe'

abiocs.name: Unusual WMI Service Start
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where WMI is used to initiate a service start from an uncommon process chain
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'wmic.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'services.exe'
| filter not (action_file_path contains 'services.exe')

xql_queries.name: Detect WMI Service Start
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'wmic.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'sc.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'services.exe'
| fields agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name, causality_actor_process_image_name
